lines.text: Even if promised a fresh start
That I believe I’m above par
I always wished for a moment of control
But I never had any restraint
And sat back as they hoped
But I have something that you don’t
A taste of your own medicine
Or were you under the influence
Do you not make the comparison
And the things that mess you up
Or someone else will destroy it
